headers.comment: The email template library is committed to the repo, so Vercel serves it — every template has been publicly readable and indexable at /email-templates/. These are internal working files: drafts, editorial notes left inside token braces, and copy awaiting compliance review. None of it should turn up in a search for the business. X-Robots-Tag keeps them reachable by URL for the team while removing them from search results. Note this is deliberately NOT paired with a robots.txt Disallow: blocking the crawl would stop Google ever reading this header, which is the one thing that reliably de-indexes a page.

Same reasoning for the staff referral intake form. It already carries a noindex meta tag; this covers it at the header level too, since the page creates participant records and is protected only by its unguessable address.
